headline_unknown: We could not read the air for your place today, so nothing is moved. Check the air card before going out.
headline_mild: {airToday} Most things are fine as they are, so the day can go ahead as planned.
headline_moderate_group: {airToday} Most of the day can go ahead; the changes below matter most for {group}.
headline_moderate: {airToday} Most of the day can go ahead; a few changes cut what your household breathes in.
headline_severe_group: {airToday} Keep {group} indoors with activity low, and protect anyone who must go out.
headline_severe_work: {airToday} The health ministry advises people at risk to stay indoors; if {group} must work outside, the steps below cut what is breathed in.
headline_severe: {airToday} Avoid outdoor exertion and use the cleaner hours for anything that must happen outside.
noair_why: We could not get an air reading for your place, so nothing is moved. Check the air card before you go out.
indoors_why: {airToday} {advice} Play or exercise indoors keeps the routine going.
move_why: {urgent}The forecast is cleaner from {window} than at {usual}. {advice}
move_urgent: If it cannot wait, go when the air is cleanest.
move_trade_slot: It moves from the {from} to the {to}. The cleaner hours come from a model forecast, not a measurement.
move_trade: The cleaner hours come from a model forecast, not a measurement.
note_car: If the car has AC, keep the windows up and the AC on recirculate, as the health ministry advises.
note_child: No study measured how well masks protect children, so keep their time outside short.
note_road: The Delhi study found the air on the road dirtier than the outside air, so take breaks away from traffic.
note_long_mask: Masks help most for short spells, so on a long shift replace it as instructed.
swap_carpool: share the ride with one more person
toggle_carpool: Share the ride with one more person
swap_why_bus: A city bus carries many people, so each one accounts for less CO₂ than in a private vehicle.
swap_why_metro: Inside a metro carriage the Delhi study measured cleaner air than outside. There is no verified CO₂ figure for the metro, so none is shown.
swap_why_carpool: Sharing the car splits its CO₂ among more people.
swap_why_cycle: On a bad air day a ride cuts what you breathe in on the way, since on a cycle you breathe much harder.
swap_add_distance: Add the distance one way to see the CO₂ change.
swap_add_riders: Add how many people ride in the vehicle to see the CO₂ change.
swap_trade_co2: It adds CO₂ that cycling does not, in exchange for breathing less on the way.
swap_trade_mixed: You may breathe in more than in a closed car with AC: up to {high}, or {low} than with the windows open.
swap_trade_more: You may breathe in more on the way than you do now: {change}.
vent_title: Air the rooms between {start} and {end} if they need it
vent_detail: Keep doors and windows shut in the morning and late evening. The health ministry says to air rooms, if needed, in the early afternoon; this is the cleanest hour of that window in the forecast.
vent_detail_no_curve: Keep doors and windows shut in the morning and late evening. The health ministry says to air rooms, if needed, in the early afternoon.
vent_mild_title: Open the windows when you like
vent_mild_detail: The health ministry's advice to keep doors and windows shut in the morning and late evening is for days with poor to severe AQI. Today is not one of them.
vent_moderate_title: If you air the rooms, the cleanest early afternoon hour is {start} to {end}
vent_moderate_detail: The health ministry asks for shut windows in the morning and late evening only on poor to severe days, so today it is your call. It names the early afternoon for airing rooms, and this is that window's cleanest hour in the forecast.
purifier_none: A purifier for this room needs at least the CADR shown.
purifier_unknown: Check the CADR on your purifier against the size shown.
purifier_ok: Your purifier meets the size shown.
purifier_small: Your purifier is smaller than this room needs.
purifier_placing: Run it where people spend the most hours, such as a bedroom at night. Avoid purifiers that make ozone. Purifiers help indoors but do not replace cleaner outdoor air.
purifier_add_title: Purifier in the {room}: add the room size
purifier_add_detail: With the floor area in sq ft, the plan works out the smallest CADR this room needs and checks your purifier against it.
mask_title: Masks: a well fitted N95 or N99, for short spells outside
mask_detail: The health ministry says paper masks, handkerchiefs, scarves and cloth are not effective, and an N95 or N99 helps only when it fits well over mouth and nose.
mask_child: No study measured how well masks protect children; the one study found looked only at whether children could wear them.
mop_detail: The health ministry advises wet mopping instead of sweeping or vacuuming inside homes, to reduce exposure.
coil_title: Do not burn a mosquito coil in a closed room
coil_detail: In a lab study one burning coil gave off as much fine particle mass as 75 to 137 cigarettes.
incense_title: Keep incense out of closed rooms
incense_detail: Burning incense gives off fine particles. The health ministry advises against burning incense sticks in closed rooms.
smoking_title: Keep smoking out of the home
smoking_detail: The health ministry advises not to smoke cigarettes, bidis or other tobacco.
fuel_title: Cook and heat with gas or electricity where you can
fuel_detail: In rural homes in four states that cook with solid fuel, PM2.5 over a day averaged 163 µg/m³ in the living area and 609 in the kitchen. The health ministry advises gas or electricity, and a clean cook stove if you must burn biomass.
plants_title: Houseplants will not clean smoky air
plants_detail: A review found it would take 10 to 1000 plants per square metre of floor to match the air a home already exchanges, and that work was on gases, not smoke particles.
cycling_title: Cycling is not the low exposure choice on a bad day
cycling_detail: Counting breathing and speed, the Delhi study found cycling takes in 9 times as much PM2.5 per km as an air-conditioned car.
alt_do_metro: take the metro, if one runs your way
alt_do_carpool: share the ride with one more person
alt_why_bus: A bus carries many people, so each one accounts for less CO₂.
alt_why_metro: There is no verified CO₂ figure for the metro, so none is shown.
alt_why_carpool: The same car trip, split between more people.
alt_do_school_bus: use the school bus or share the school run
alt_why_school_bus: One vehicle carrying many children replaces several car trips. There is no verified CO₂ figure for school buses, so none is shown.
alt_do_errands: make one trip that covers them all
alt_why_errands: Fewer trips mean fewer km driven. The saving depends on the route, so no figure is shown.
alt_do_fuel: cook on LPG, piped gas or induction
alt_why_fuel: The health ministry advises clean smokeless fuels such as gas or electricity for cooking and heating.
alt_do_coil: use a bed net or a plug-in repellent that does not burn
alt_why_coil: It keeps mosquitoes off without smoke in a closed room.
advice_note: Health ministry advice is quoted word for word from its advisory.
